consultationsDescription: Start or join a scheduled audio/video appointment. Your microphone and camera remain off until you provide consent and enable them.
mediaPrivacyNotice: Live audio and video are shared only with the other appointment participant. This feature does not record calls. Enable your microphone or camera only after reviewing the consent notice.
signalingUnavailable: Secure call signaling is unavailable. Check your connection or contact support.
callCouldNotStart: The call could not be started. Please retry.
callBusy: You or the other participant is already in a call.
callAccepted: Call accepted. Review the consent notice before enabling your devices.
callConsentNotice: Your live audio and video are shared with the other appointment participant. No recording is started by this feature.
callConsent: I understand and agree to enable my microphone or camera for this call.
remoteAudioOnly: The other participant is connected using audio only.
waitingForAcceptance: Waiting for the other participant to accept...
waitingForParticipant: Waiting for the other participant to connect...
participantOffline: The other participant is currently offline. The call will time out if they do not reconnect.
participantReconnecting: The other participant disconnected. Waiting for them to reconnect...
turnUnavailable: Secure call relay is not configured. Contact your administrator before starting a call.
unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not support secure audio/video calls. Please use an up-to-date browser over HTTPS.
microphoneDenied: Microphone or camera permission was denied. Allow access in your browser settings and retry.
mediaDeviceMissing: A required microphone or camera was not found. Connect a device and retry.
mediaDeviceError: The microphone or camera could not be started. Check browser permissions and device settings.
videoFallback: Camera access failed, so this call will continue with audio only.
callNegotiationFailed: A secure media connection could not be negotiated. End the call and retry.
networkConnectionFailed: Network connection failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
connectionTimeout: The connection is taking too long. Check your network or try again.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again before continuing.
callCouldNotJoin: Could not join this call. It may have ended or the appointment may no longer be active.
callEndNetworkWarning: The call ended locally, but the server could not be notified. It will close after the reconnect timeout.
cameraSwitchFailed: Could not switch cameras. Check that the other camera is available.
fullscreenUnavailable: Fullscreen mode is not available in this browser.
pictureInPictureUnavailable: Picture-in-picture is not available in this browser.
noDoctorsAvailable: No doctors are available to book right now.
callServiceUnavailable: Audio/video calling is disabled. Configure CALL_TOKEN_SECRET, STUN_URIS, TURN_URIS and TURN_SHARED_SECRET on the backend, then restart it.
noEligibleAppointments: No upcoming audio/video appointments are available.
consultationPrepared: Consultation is ready. Join is available during the appointment call window.
consultationWindow: Join is available from 30 minutes before until 60 minutes after the appointment.
appointmentNotActive: This appointment is no longer active.
consultationOutsideWindow: The call is not within the appointment time window.
consultationNotAvailable: This consultation is not available to join.
consultationActionFailed: The consultation action could not be completed.
openMeetingInNewTab: Open meeting in a new tab
videoUnavailable: Video conferencing is not configured. Contact your administrator.
deviceError: Camera or microphone access was denied or is unavailable. Check your browser permissions and device.
controlError: This call control is unavailable. Use the controls inside the meeting window.
teleconsultationConsentRequired: Teleconsultation consent is required before this session can be prepared. Update privacy settings first.
